description:
曲绘经过两个入允许上传
This is Calepam; I’m glad to be creating chart again! I’ll write a version with a lower difficulty level later on. This chart is a continuation of ’星茶会’ and retains many of its performance elements and settings. I love you all, and I love all the composers in the Phira community – enjoy~
*calepam chart team允许大多数对calepam名义的使用，包括合作谱师，伪造谱师栏
我是一个英语母语的外国人，喜欢游玩pjsk，maimai，phira，phigros，
name: 月茶会
